verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਚਾਰ ਜੁਗ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਤਰੁਵਰੁ ਪਰਬਤ ਸਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: khaanee baanee chaar jug jal thal taruvar parabat saaje|

en.bdb: Four mines of life, four speeches and four Ages included, the Lord created water, earth, trees, and mountains.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿੰਨ ਲੋਅ ਚੌਦਹ ਭਵਣ ਕਰਿ ਇਕੀਹ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: ti(n)n loa chauadheh bhavan kar ikeeh brahama(n)dd nivaaje|

en.bdb: The one Lord created the three worlds, fourteen spheres and many universes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਦੀਪ ਸਤ ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਜਣਿ ਵਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: chaare ku(n)ddaa dheep sat nau kha(n)dd dheh dhis vajan vaaje|

en.bdb: For Him the musical instruments are being played at in all the ten directions, seven continents and nine divisions of the universe.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਖਾਣਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਇਕੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਲਖ ਉਪਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: eikas ikas khaan vich ikeeh ikeeh lakh upaaje|

en.bdb: From each originating source, twenty-one lacs of creatures have been produced.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤ ਇਕਤ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤੁ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਬਿਰਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: eikat ikat joon vich jeea ja(n)t anaganat biraaje|

en.bdb: Then in each species innumerable creatures exist.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਕਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਗਾਜੇ।
verses.translit_en: roop anoop saroop kar ra(n)g bira(n)g tara(n)g agaaje|

en.bdb: Incomparable forms and hues then appearnd in variegated waves (of life).
Bodies formed by the association of air and water, have nine doors each.
